LanguageData.RavenResearch_TrapBasics.label: [Raven] Trap Basics
LanguageData.RavenResearch_TrapBasics.description: Study the fundamental principles of Raven defensive engineering. Unlocks simple mechanical traps like the leg crusher.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_Concealment.label: [Raven] Concealment Tactics
LanguageData.RavenResearch_Concealment.description: Unlocks advanced camouflage structures that allow snipers to remain hidden while engaging targets.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_SpecialTraps.label: [Raven] Specialized Traps
LanguageData.RavenResearch_SpecialTraps.description: Unlocks unconventional traps designed for psychological warfare and specialized capture, such as Lego mines and Conception machines.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_DynamicTerrain.label: [Raven] Dynamic Terrain Defense
LanguageData.RavenResearch_DynamicTerrain.description: Unlocks the massive Rising Wall Trap, capable of altering the battlefield instantly by generating walls.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_DecoyTech.label: [Raven] Decoy Technology
LanguageData.RavenResearch_DecoyTech.description: Develop realistic decoys and sound lures to deceive enemy AI.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_ChemicalWarfare.label: [Raven] Chemical Warfare
LanguageData.RavenResearch_ChemicalWarfare.descriptio: Research various gases for area denial and crowd control.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_AdvancedTrap.label: [Raven] Advanced Trap Tech
LanguageData.RavenResearch_AdvancedTrap.description: Advanced structural engineering and sensor arrays. Unlocks the defense hub for centralized turret management.
